final: SELECT SUM(s.total_sum) AS sum_of_totals, AVG(s.cnt) AS avg_of_counts FROM (SELECT c.State AS state, SUM(i.Total) AS total_sum, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM Invoice i JOIN Customer c ON c.CustomerId = i.CustomerId WHERE i.InvoiceDate >= '2010-06-22 00:00:00' AND i.InvoiceDate <= '2012-06-26 00:00:00' GROUP BY c.State) s
